data.text: I’ll commit to 15 tons this harvest and donate the full $15,000 to the clinic. With our four contributions, that meets today’s $60,000 requirement. I’ll also keep my catch to no more than 6 tons next month, then 10 tons once the lake is back at 100. Let’s record the catches and donation receipts together so we can keep both promises—to our neighbors and to the lake. Luke, will you confirm zero this month and no more than 6 tons next month?
